name: Amarantovoye Nebo
source:
"Sometimes we get so tangled up in our own feelings that living becomes simply unbearable... This is especially true for an ordinary eleventh-grader who understands neither himself nor the girls around him. Will he be able to make the right choice when everyone around him keeps telling him what to do?"

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3035528544]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“有时候，我们太纠结于自己的感受，以至于生活变得难以忍受……尤其是对于一个普通的十一年级学生来说，他既不了解自己，也不了解周围的女孩。当周围的人都在告诉他该做什么时，他能做出正确的选择吗？”

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3035528544]Steam[/url]]
